# M13-S2: synthetic PGO (SPEC T-105). Standard emits Cold into ? blocks
# and before os.Exit; aggressive adds explicit panics; off emits nothing.
# Assembly probes scope -S to the fixture package and disable inlining
# and intrinsics so an emitted Cold call survives to the dump.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# O2 defaults to standard: the ? block emits Cold.
cd std
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthstd=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' .
stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
logos run .
stdout '^0 boom$'
stdout '^3$'
stdout '^3$'

# off at O3: no Cold emission anywhere.
cd ../off
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthoff=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=3 .
! stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
stderr 'main\.divide\S* STEXT'
logos run -O=3 .
stdout '^0 boom$'

# aggressive at O2: the ? block still emits; the panic path is marked
# with no call.
cd ../aggr
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthaggr=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=2 .
stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
logos run -O=2 .
stdout '^0 boom$'

# An explicit -gcflags level overrides the default.
cd ../std
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthstd=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2 -d=logossynthpgo=off' .
! stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
stderr 'main\.divide\S* STEXT'

# Without the key, O3 selects aggressive and still emits.
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthstd=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=3 .
stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'

# O0, O1, Os, and Oz emit nothing, even with an explicit key.
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthstd=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=0 .
! stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
stderr 'main\.divide\S* STEXT'
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthstd=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=1 .
! stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
stderr 'main\.divide\S* STEXT'
cd ../aggr
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthaggr=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=1 .
! stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
stderr 'main\.divide\S* STEXT'
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthaggr=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=s .
! stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
stderr 'main\.divide\S* STEXT'
logos build -gcflags='example.com/synthaggr=-l -d=ssa/intrinsics/off -S=2' -O=z .
! stderr 'CALL\s+logos/rt\.Cold\(SB\)'
stderr 'main\.divide\S* STEXT'

-- std/go.mod --
module example.com/synthstd

go 1.27

-- std/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func fail() (int, error) {
	return 0, errors.New("boom")
}

func divide() (int, error) {
	v := fail()?
	return v, nil
}

func check(n int) int {
	if n < 0 {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	return n
}

func mustBePositive(n int) int {
	if n < 0 {
		panic("negative")
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	v, err := divide()
	fmt.Println(v, err)
	fmt.Println(check(3))
	fmt.Println(mustBePositive(3))
}

-- off/go.mod --
module example.com/synthoff

go 1.27

-- off/logos.toml --
[project]
name = "synthoff"

[build]
synthetic_pgo = "off"

-- off/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func fail() (int, error) {
	return 0, errors.New("boom")
}

func divide() (int, error) {
	v := fail()?
	return v, nil
}

func check(n int) int {
	if n < 0 {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	return n
}

func mustBePositive(n int) int {
	if n < 0 {
		panic("negative")
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	v, err := divide()
	fmt.Println(v, err)
	fmt.Println(check(3))
	fmt.Println(mustBePositive(3))
}

-- aggr/go.mod --
module example.com/synthaggr

go 1.27

-- aggr/logos.toml --
[project]
name = "synthaggr"

[build]
synthetic_pgo = "aggressive"

-- aggr/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func fail() (int, error) {
	return 0, errors.New("boom")
}

func divide() (int, error) {
	v := fail()?
	return v, nil
}

func check(n int) int {
	if n < 0 {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	return n
}

func mustBePositive(n int) int {
	if n < 0 {
		panic("negative")
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	v, err := divide()
	fmt.Println(v, err)
	fmt.Println(check(3))
	fmt.Println(mustBePositive(3))
}
